articles.summary: JEFFERSON CITY, Mo., Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Hawthorn Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: HWBK) , (the “Company”), the bank holding company for Hawthorn Bank, reported third quarter 2026 net income of $7.1 million, or earnings per diluted share (“EPS”) of $1.01. Third Quarter 2026 Results Net income improved $0.9 million, or 15.2% , to $7.1 million from the third quarter 2025 (the "prior year quarter"). Adjusted net income (a) for the third quarter 2026 was $8.6 million. The efficiency ratio was 65.00% compared to 62.30% for the prior year quarter. The adjusted efficiency ratio (a) for the third quarter 2026 was 55.64%. EPS of $1.01 , an improvement of $0.13 per share, or 15% , from the prior year quarter. Adjusted EPS (a) for the third quarter 2026 was $1.23 , an increase of 38.2% over the prior year quarter. articles.summary: JEFFERSON CITY, Mo., Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Hawthorn Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: HWBK) announced today that on October 28, 2026 its Board of Directors approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.21 per common share. The dividend is payable on January 1, 2027 to shareholders of record at the close of business on December 15, 2026. About Hawthorn Bancshares, Inc. Hawthorn Bancshares, Inc., a bank holding company headquartered in Jefferson City, Missouri, is the parent company of Hawthorn Bank, which has served families and businesses for more than 160 years. Hawthorn Bank operates branch offices in central, southern, northwest Missouri, and also the Kansas City metropolitan area, including one branch in Kansas. Contact: Hawthorn Bancshares, Inc. Brent M.
